description: Where a request to Vuelo's support team stands: with the team, replied (the reply is in the traveller's email), or resolved. Pass the ticket reference (SUP-...) and either the taskId of the booking in this conversation or the email the traveller gave. Use it when the traveller asks for an update. To add to a request, call contact_support again with the same booking and reason: it joins the same conversation.

email.description: The email the traveller gave for the reply.

mobile.description: Or the mobile on the request.

taskId.description: The booking's taskId, if it was made in this conversation.

name: get_support_ticket
